title: The public site's settings
description: One site for every specification under specs/ (src/site/): its host, its publisher, the public repository it links, where its deploy command copies it, and the specs it lists, in order.

name.description: The site's name in the header, as in "<name> JSON Schema".

lead.description: The root page's opening paragraphs, in order. A backtick span is code and `**x**` is bold.

publisher.description: Who publishes the site, as every page says.

repo.description: The public repository of this tooling, whose folders the site links in place of downloads; empty for none.

deploy.description: Where the deploy command, which is printed and never run, copies the site.

specs.description: The specs the root lists, in order, each a folder under specs/ whose profile has a site.
